post1.quote: swallowed chewing gum does not stay in our stomachs for seven years

post2.quote: not remain in the stomach for seven years

post3.quote: an accidentally swallowed piece will not linger in our stomachs for seven years

paragraph.quote: We’ve all heard the seven-year warning, but it is a myth.

raw.note_quote: We can’t present a false health claim as fact. Swallowed gum generally passes through the digestive system within days; it does not remain in the stomach for seven years.
